mysql.rationale: Deterministic backslash-escape and double-quote semantics for every target connection; fingerprint lexing assumes the same mode. NO_BACKSLASH_ESCAPES and ANSI_QUOTES are excluded.

common_invariants: Every call accepts context cancellation and a finite adapter-level connect timeout.
Credentials and TLS material are decrypted only at connection construction and are never returned by an adapter result.
Server identity is engine-specific, stable across credential rotation and compared with the frozen datasource identity before review reuse or execution.
Identifiers are never interpolated from user text; they are resolved from metadata IDs or frozen mappings and quoted by the engine adapter.
Raw SQL is supplied only to target-database driver execution methods and never to AI providers, logs, metrics, traces or errors.
Explain never enables ANALYZE or another option that executes mutating SQL.
Driver error text is classified and sanitized before leaving the adapter.
The adapter never retries a statement, transaction commit, DDL or gh-ost process internally.
Unsupported syntax or capability fails closed and never falls back to a different dialect or direct high-risk execution.

mysql.explain: EXPLAIN without executing the statement; JSON format only when the verified target supports it
mysql.dml_transaction: sql.Tx covering every frozen DML statement in one datasource stage
mysql.cancel: close or cancel the dedicated driver connection; cancellation confirmation does not prove transaction outcome after commit send

postgresql.dml_transaction: sql.Tx covering every frozen DML statement in one datasource stage
postgresql.cancel: PostgreSQL cancel request plus dedicated connection close; cancellation confirmation does not prove transaction outcome after commit send

compatibility_modes.rule: Vendor targets reuse the MySQL or PostgreSQL SQL dialect adapter only after target-specific capability probes and golden tests pass.

query_cursor.metadata_persistence: encrypted query_cursors row only using cursor_state_ciphertext, cursor_state_nonce, cursor_state_key_id and cursor_state_algorithm under cryptographic-key-contract.json
query_cursor.routing: Signed cursor-affinity cookie routes all continuation requests to the owning Pod; application-level inter-Pod RPC is forbidden.
query_cursor.buffering: At most one configured page plus driver framing overhead in memory; no whole-result buffering or prefetch.
query_cursor.snapshot: Pages from one live cursor observe the target database cursor snapshot/statement semantics; no cross-Pod reconstruction.
query_cursor.authorization: Every page validates current session/grant state, frozen datasource capability and purpose; export additionally requires can_export.
query_cursor.security_boundary: can_export controls the audited built-in export path but cannot prevent manual collection through authorized display pagination.
query_cursor.cleanup: Owner closes the target cursor/connection on exhaustion, cancellation, session close, idle expiry or the fixed six-hour absolute lifetime; metadata deletion is handled by the retention role.

test_gate.targets: every target/version frozen in the release manifest

review_metadata_extension.mode: optional bounded read-only parameterized metadata capability, six canonical interfaces retained
review_metadata_extension.existence: observed base-table present/absent; visibility failure is unknown, and a same-name non-base relation is unsupported rather than absent
review_metadata_extension.estimates: metadata only, no COUNT(*) or mutation; unknown/unsupported explicit, never fabricated zero
review_metadata_extension.provider_projection: safe typed column/index facts and anonymous identifiers; no default/comment/engine free text; a custom or domain type is redacted as type_class=other with type_status=unknown and makes the column profile incomplete rather than being treated as a known type
review_metadata_extension.array_types: controlled built-in arrays retain array class, element class and dimensions; unknown element types are redacted and incomplete
review_metadata_extension.index_structure: key and INCLUDE columns remain distinct; expression counts and prefix presence/lengths are controlled facts; unprojected expressions or prefix ordering make the profile incomplete
review_metadata_extension.safe_explain_boundary: construct final SQL only after dialect token validation proves one ordinary statement head and no separators or execution prefix; no target connection is needed to reject unsafe input

policy_catalog_privacy.interface: optional trusted ReadPolicyCatalog capability; no Provider-facing tool
policy_catalog_privacy.snapshot: single bounded catalog query; complete schema visibility proof required; no partial return
